The original sheet’s Printful partner logo is rejected. Root replaced it during the audit with the recognizable HighLevel three-arrow mark; this current identity matches the official brand-kit arrow description. Prefer a sharper original for large use.
assets.replacement: Use the current arrow at a size it can support or obtain the official original from the brand kit.
assets.replacementLimit: Direct images linked in official brand kit, not independently rendered in this audit. Preserve original proportions/colors.

assets.reason: The contact sheet showed Zoho Service Plus, a different product. During audit, the asset changed to the generic Zoho corporate favicon. That fixes the Service Plus mismatch but still does not establish an exact Desk mark.
assets.replacement: Prefer the actual Desk product logo or ordinary Zoho Desk text. Current generic Zoho corporate mark requires explicit parent-company labeling.
assets.replacementLimit: Web fetch reached image/svg+xml; tool could not render SVG. Root must inspect the actual graphic before treating it as visually cleared.

assets.reason: The current red-S image is the Shopify Inbox top icon, not JivoChat. JivoChat’s unavailable Shopify listing exposes a different top product image on storage.googleapis.com; Shopify Inbox appears later in More apps like this. Matching hashes confirm the wrong related-app image was reused.
assets.replacement: Use an original JivoChat mark from its own website, or ordinary JivoChat text. The signed original listing image expired in the web fetch; do not use the Shopify Inbox recommendation image.

assets.reason: Despite visual suspicion, Shopify’s current official Inbox listing labels this exact red-S asset as its top Shopify Inbox product image before the gallery. The reuse for JivoChat is wrong; this association is affirmative primary evidence for Inbox.

Recognizable Vonage V from official developer favicon; native source is only 48px and visibly soft when enlarged. Keep small or use ordinary text.

limitations: Manifest changed while audit was underway. Decisions are bound to reviewedAssetURL/reviewedSha256; recheck later replacements rather than inheriting a blanket verified flag.
An official page can contain partner logos, recommended apps, documentation-host icons and corporate parent marks. HTTP success and a logo-like filename alone do not establish product identity.
For uncertainty or inadequate resolution, use the ordinary brand name. Do not create a substitute graphic.
Allow means no identity mismatch detected within this stated evidence; product-specific holds need an exact mark or accurate corporate labeling.
No artwork was downloaded, edited or composed during this review; image URLs are evidence/candidates, not newly accepted replacements.
